#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST_NAME, COMPENSATE, AVG_SALARY_FD, COMPENSATE_FD, ECCAMT, LEFT_TYPE, TAX FROM (SELECT EMPID, LEFT_TYPE, AVG_SALARY, COMPENSATE, AVG_SALARY_FD, COMPENSATE_FD, ROUND(AVG_SALARY_FD * COMPENSATE_FD, 2) ECCAMT, CASE WHEN AVG_SALARY_FD * COMPENSATE_FD >= TO_NUMBER(#ECCMIANSHUI#) THEN TRUNC(GET_PI_TAX(#EMPID#,(AVG_SALARY_FD * COMPENSATE_FD - TO_NUMBER(#ECCMIANSHUI#)) / CASE WHEN CEIL(HR_GET_WORKMONTH_NOW(#EMPID#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#EXPECTDATELEFT#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM'), #interCpnyID#) / 12) > 12 THEN 12 ELSE CEIL(HR_GET_WORKMONTH_NOW(#EMPID#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#EXPECTDATELEFT#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM'), #interCpnyID#) / 12) END, #interCpnyID#) *CASE WHEN CEIL(HR_GET_WORKMONTH_NOW(#EMPID#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#EXPECTDATELEFT#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM'), #interCpnyID#) / 12) > 12 THEN 12 ELSE CEIL(HR_GET_WORKMONTH_NOW(#EMPID#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#EXPECTDATELEFT#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM'), #interCpnyID#) / 12) END) ELSE 0 END TAX FROM ( SELECT #EMPID# EMPID, '不续签合同' LEFT_TYPE, GET_PA_ECC_AVG_SALARY(#EMPID#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#EXPECTDATELEFT#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM'), #ECCMIN#, #ECCMAX#, '', #interCpnyID#) AVG_SALARY, GET_PA_ECC_COMPENSATION_MONTHS(#EMPID#, 'leftReasonType001', #EXPECTDATELEFT#, #ECCMAX#, GET_PA_ECC_AVG_SALARY(#EMPID#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#EXPECTDATELEFT#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM'), #ECCMIN#, #ECCMAX#, '', #interCpnyID#), '', #interCpnyID#) COMPENSATE, GET_PA_ECC_AVG_SALARY(#EMPID#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#EXPECTDATELEFT#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM'), #ECCMIN#, #ECCMAX#, 'FD', #interCpnyID#) AVG_SALARY_FD, GET_PA_ECC_COMPENSATION_MONTHS(#EMPID#, 'leftReasonType001', #EXPECTDATELEFT#, #ECCMAX#, GET_PA_ECC_AVG_SALARY(#EMPID#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#EXPECTDATELEFT#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM'), #ECCMIN#, #ECCMAX#, 'FD', #interCpnyID#), 'FD', #interCpnyID#) COMPENSATE_FD FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT #EMPID# EMPID, '劝告离职' LEFT_TYPE, GET_PA_ECC_AVG_SALARY(#EMPID#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#EXPECTDATELEFT#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM'), #ECCMIN#, #ECCMAX#, '', #interCpnyID#) AVG_SALARY, GET_PA_ECC_COMPENSATION_MONTHS(#EMPID#, 'leftReasonType002', #EXPECTDATELEFT#, #ECCMAX#, GET_PA_ECC_AVG_SALARY(#EMPID#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#EXPECTDATELEFT#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM'), #ECCMIN#, #ECCMAX#, '', #interCpnyID#), '', #interCpnyID#) COMPENSATE, GET_PA_ECC_AVG_SALARY(#EMPID#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#EXPECTDATELEFT#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM'), #ECCMIN#, #ECCMAX#, 'FD', #interCpnyID#) AVG_SALARY_FD, GET_PA_ECC_COMPENSATION_MONTHS(#EMPID#, 'leftReasonType002', #EXPECTDATELEFT#, #ECCMAX#, GET_PA_ECC_AVG_SALARY(#EMPID#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#EXPECTDATELEFT#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM'), #ECCMIN#, #ECCMAX#, 'FD', #interCpnyID#), 'FD', #interCpnyID#) COMPENSATE_FD FROM DUAL) A UNION ALL SELECT #EMPID#, '协议离职' LEFT_TYPE, 0, 0, 0, 0, NVL(TO_NUMBER(#XIEYIJIN#), 0), CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(#XIEYIJIN#) >= TO_NUMBER(#ECCMIANSHUI#) THEN TRUNC(GET_PI_TAX(#EMPID#,(TO_NUMBER(#XIEYIJIN#) - TO_NUMBER(#ECCMIANSHUI#)) / CASE WHEN CEIL(HR_GET_WORKMONTH_NOW(#EMPID#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#EXPECTDATELEFT#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM'), #interCpnyID#) / 12) > 12 THEN 12 ELSE CEIL(HR_GET_WORKMONTH_NOW(#EMPID#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#EXPECTDATELEFT#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM'), #interCpnyID#) / 12) END, #interCpnyID#) *CASE WHEN CEIL(HR_GET_WORKMONTH_NOW(#EMPID#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#EXPECTDATELEFT#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM'), #interCpnyID#) / 12) > 12 THEN 12 ELSE CEIL(HR_GET_WORKMONTH_NOW(#EMPID#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#EXPECTDATELEFT#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM'), #interCpnyID#) / 12) END) ELSE 0 END TAX FROM DUAL) A, HR_EMPLOYEE B WHERE A.EMPID = B.EMPID AND B.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID# ORDER BY A.LEFT_TYPE

SELECT T.*, HRE.LOCAL_NAME LOCAL_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(HRE.DEPTNO,#interLanguage#) DEPTNAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HRE.GRADE_LEVEL, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) GRADE_LEVEL_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HRE.DUTY_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DUTY_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HRE.POST_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST_NAME FROM T_PA_ECC_RESULT T LEFT JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE HRE ON T.EMPID = HRE.EMPID WHERE hre.cpny_id=#interCpnyID#
T.PA_MONTH = #PA_MONTH#

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_PA_ECC_RESULT T WHERE T.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID#
T.PA_MONTH = #PA_MONTH#

sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM T_PA_ECC_RESULT T WHERE T.EMPID = #EMPID# AND t.cpny_id=#CPNY_ID# AND T.PA_MONTH = #PA_MONTH# AND T.BATCHES = #batches#
sqlMap.update: update t_pa_ecc_result set left_type = #leftType:varchar# ,ecc_amt = #eccAmt:numeric# ,notice_amt = #noticeAmt:numeric# ,AVG_SALARY = null ,COMPENSATION_MONTH = null ,AVG_SALARY_FD = null ,COMPENSATION_MONTH_FD = null ,UPDATE_TAX = #eccTax:numeric# where pa_ecc_no = #eccNo:numeric#
sqlMap.select: select batchValue from ( select batches batchValue from pa_ecc_progress where pa_month = #paMonth# union all select nvl(max(batches),0) + 1 from pa_ecc_progress where pa_month = #paMonth# ) a order by a.batchValue desc
SELECT SETTLEMENT FROM PA_ECC_PROGRESS T WHERE T.PA_MONTH = #PA_MONTH# AND T.BATCHES = #BATCHES:NUMERIC# AND T.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID#
SELECT T.PA_ECC_NO FROM T_PA_ECC_RESULT T WHERE T.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID# AND T.PA_MONTH = #PA_MONTH# AND T.BATCHES = #batches# AND ROWNUM=1

SELECT PA.PA_MONTH PAMONTH, PA.BATCHES BATCHES, HRE.LOCAL_NAME LOCAL_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(HRE.DEPTNO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HRE.GRADE_LEVEL, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) GRADE_LEVEL_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HRE.DUTY_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DUTY_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HRE.POST_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST_NAME, HRE.DATE_STARTED DATE_STARTED, HRE.DATE_LEFT DATE_LEFT, PA.LEFT_TYPE LEFT_TYPE, PA.MONTH_START FROM T_PA_ECC_RESULT PA LEFT JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE HRE ON HRE.EMPID = PA.EMPID WHERE HRE.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID# AND HRE.EMPID = #EMPID#
SELECT T.BASE_SALARY FROM PA_HISTORY_C02 T WHERE T.PA_MONTH = #PA_MONTH# AND T.EMPID = #EMPID# AND T.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID# AND #PA_MONTH# >= #PA_MONTH_START#
